content.title: Portland Trail Blazers vs. Denver Nuggets: How to watch streaming live, game preview, odds
content.text: Portland Trail BlazersGuard Christian Braun (0) and the Denver Nuggets host Deni Avdija (left) and the Portland Trail Blazers on Monday night at Ball Arena.AP Photo/Ali GradischerBy Joe Freeman | The Oregonian/OregonLiveThe Portland Trail Blazers play the Denver Nuggets on Monday in an NBA matchup at Moda Center.Here are the details:PORTLAND TRAIL BLAZERS (40-38) vs. DENVER NUGGETS (50-28)When: 6 p.m., Monday, April 6Where: Ball Arena, DenverRadio: Rip City Radio (KPOJ 620 AM).TV channel: KUNP (Antenna: 47.1. Xfinity: 16, 302, 1170. DirecTV: 47. Spectrum: 184), NBATV.Online: Seventy-six of the Blazers’ 82 games this season can be streamed live or on-demand via BlazerVision for an annual fee of $120. For more information about Rip City TV and how to watch Blazers games, visit nba.com/blazers/watchTrail Blazers vs Spurs NBA Playoffs tickets are on sale now — Here’s where fans can get the best deals Trail Blazers vs. Spurs: Western Conference playoff scheduleThe most improbable Blazers season got its most improbable endingDeni Avdija was already an All-Star. Play-in win was his superstar moment| Bill OramTrail Blazers rally to stun Suns in NBA play-in tournament, clinch playoff berthODDS (Oregon Lottery/DraftKings)Moneyline: DEN -310 | POR +250Spread: DEN -7.5 | Over/Under: 238.5This and that: The Blazers have won three in a row and eight of the last 10 to surge into a tie for eighth place in the Western Conference, one-half game ahead of the Los Angeles Clippers. ... Portland is two games over .500 for the first time since Nov. 5. ... The Blazers defeated the New Orleans Pelicans 118-106 on Friday night in Portland. Jrue Holiday had 27 points and nine assists, Deni Avdija recorded 26 points, eight rebounds and seven assists and Toumani Camara added 23 points and three steals in the win. ... Camara drew four offensive fouls, including three charges, against the Pelicans, giving him 102 this season — the most by any player in any season since the league started tracking the statistic in 2005-06. ... Scoot Henderson, who missed the first 51 games with a hamstring injury, is averaging 16.1 points, while shooting 46% from the field, over the last 14 games. ... The Nuggets have won eight in a row and 11 of the last 13 overall. They own the longest-active winning streak in the NBA. ... The Nuggets defeated the San Antonio Spurs 136-134 in overtime on Saturday in one of the best and most entertaining games this season. ... Nikola Jokic finished with 40 points, 13 assists, eight rebounds and three blocks and Christian Braun recorded 21 points, eight rebounds and four assists in the win. ... This is the fourth and final meeting between the teams this season. The Blazers defeated the Nuggets 109-107 on Halloween, but have suffered a pair of decisive defeats to Denver since the All-Star break, falling 157-103 on Feb. 22 and 128-112 on March 22. INJURIESPortland: Jerami Grant (right calf strain), Vit Krejci (left calf bruise), Shaedon Sharpe (left calf strain/fibula injury) and Damian Lillard (left Achilles tendon) are out.Denver: Bruce Brown (left ankle sprain) is probable; Zeke Nnaji (left hip sprain) is questionable; and Spencer Jones (right hamstring strain) and Peyton Watson (right hamstring strain) are out. NEXT UPThe Blazers play the San Antonio Spurs on Wednesday at 6:30 p.m. at Frost Bank Center.Joe Freeman is a senior writer at The Oregonian/OregonLive, who covers the Portland Trail Blazers and the NBA.
